#include <stdint.h>
uint32_t pc(uint32_t x) { uint32_t c = 0; for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) c += (x >> i) & 1; return c; }

#include <stdint.h>
uint64_t rev(uint64_t x) { x = (x & 0xF0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0ull) >> 4 | (x & 0x0F0F0F0F0F0F0F0Full) << 4; x = (x & 0xCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCull) >> 2 | (x & 0x3333333333333333ull) << 2; return (x & 0xAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAull) >> 1 | (x & 0x5555555555555555ull) << 1; }
